title: Joint Business Holders: Adding Multiple Account Owners
summary: Explains how to add multiple joint business account owners, including eligibility (max 4 owners), required owner details, steps from the account dashboard (Add owner → submit for review), and the post-submission invitation/verification process. Also covers optional Admin/Finance/Auditor role assignment with a one-time fee of $0.00 for advanced user roles and permissions.
faqs: What is the maximum number of joint business account owners I can add?
What details do I need to gather to add a new joint business owner?
How do I add a new owner from the account dashboard?
Can I assign Admin, Finance, or Auditor access when adding an owner, and what is the one-time fee?
What happens after I submit an owner addition—do they get an invitation and how can I track it?
